packs.author: ALE stock
packs.description: A calm paper-and-ink design system: warm surfaces, one blue accent, generous spacing, and a plain serif/sans pairing for document-like apps.

guide.description: Warm paper surfaces with ink text and a single blue accent. Controls stay flat and bordered; colour is spent on state, not decoration.

icons.usage: One set, drawn at 16px, stroked not filled.

guide.name: Quiet Paper
guide.principles: Flat surfaces, hairline borders, no shadows except menus. One accent colour, used for the current selection and primary actions only. Text is ink on paper at every size; secondary text is a step lighter, never a different hue.
guide.voice: Plain, second person, no exclamation marks.

packs.name: Quiet Paper
